constants_justification: Declared before circuit dry run: 20 Hz forward minus backward reaches maximum walking speed 0.02 units/ms; 20 Hz turn difference reaches 0.005 rad/ms. Backward speed limited to half maximum. These constants are not calibrated.
escape_rule: true on any escape_left or escape_right spike in the interval

rate_filter.group_rate: mean spikes per neuron per second

turn_rate.body_side_to_turn_direction: MODEL ASSUMPTION. A left-side group contributes positive turn and a right-side group contributes negative turn. This is not a measured fact.
